args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks with an error rate of ~18%. (The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging.) Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After rollback: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. The SEV2 incident is open as INC-0001.

1. **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%. The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. The v2.3.1 test build (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed health checks in staging.
2. **Rollback:** I rolled back to v2.3.0, which needed no approval because it was already healthy in production. All three regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
3. **Incident:** I opened INC-0001 as a SEV2 for checkout-api, which pages on-call. The request timed out, but checking the incident list showed it had been created, so I didn't retry. There's exactly one incident and no duplicate page. It records what happened, the rollback, the health after the rollback, and a follow-up to find the v2.3.1 problem before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
